letter:
My dearest Liza, my jaan, my forever cutie,  
Every sunrise in Dubai and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful chaos with you. As the calendar turns toward the warm glow of spring, I find my heart humming the same love song we danced to on 23 Feb 2025. Whether we’re strolling the dunes or sipping chai by the Sabarmati, you are my compass, my laughter, my home. I love you more with each passing day, and I can’t wait for the adventures that lie ahead.
poem:
In dunes or by the river’s side,  
Your smile is where my worlds collide.  
From Dubai heat to Ahmedabad rain,  
With you, my love, I’m whole again.
